If you want to get the updates about latest chapters, lets create an account and add One Piece to your bookmark. As a child, Monkey D. Luffy dreamed of becoming the King of the Pirates. But his life changed when he accidentally gained the power to stretch like rubber...at the cost of never being able to swim again! Now Luffy, with the help of a motley collection of nakama, is setting off in search of "One Piece," said to be the greatest treasure in the world...

One Piece is a captivating comic created by Oda Eiichiro, belonging to the Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy, Drama, Action, Others genre.
